a: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي رَدَّ كَيْدَهُ إِلَى الْوَسْوَسَةِ
p: Allāhu akbar (×3). Al-ḥamdu lillāhi-lladhī radda kaydahu ila-l-waswasah.
m: Allah is greatest, three times. All praise is for Allah, who turned his plotting back into mere whispering.
